verdicts.reason: Both share the same flaws: the symptom list is tiny and badly rewrapped ('Sore throat Headache' on one line, 'Dry cough' tacked onto 'breath') and jammed against the top edge; 'SYMPTOMS' butts into the doctor, who is cropped into a hard white box; the hashtag bar is shrunk to a floating box; and the sparkle sits alone and oversized on the right. A's CTA runs almost to the right edge, while B wraps it shorter and keeps some margin, so B is slightly less cramped.
